oracle_policy: Expected IDs, timestamps, paths, review candidates, conflicts, and ACL invariants are fixed in the planner packet and this artifact before query implementation; candidate output is never used to derive expected values.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Query an explicitly owned cold graph before seeding.
cases.setup: Create a unique graph; do not seed it.
cases.failure_detected: Phantom fixture defaults or absence misrepresented as current.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Query one minute before the new assignment's effective time.
cases.setup: Seed R1 and append R2 with the pinned observed/effective timestamps.
cases.failure_detected: Observed time confused with effective time, or revision backdated.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Query at the exact effective boundary.
cases.setup: Use append-only R1/R2 sources and assignments with explicit supersession.
cases.failure_detected: History overwritten, wrong boundary semantics, or unproven reassignment.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Compare explicit citation dependents with a textually similar artifact lacking dependency edges.
cases.setup: Seed linked handover/ticket and lexical-only handover; update source without rewriting artifacts.
cases.failure_detected: Lexical guess treated as dependency, artifacts rewritten, or incomplete coverage claimed.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Re-evaluate existing conflicting current SOP claims after roster update.
cases.setup: Seed both V2/V3 unresolved source-backed claims; run source update.
cases.failure_detected: Source freshness incorrectly resolves unrelated disagreement.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Attach fixed restricted source, fact, equipment, department and role to a hidden path.
cases.setup: Capture operations output, add restricted facts, and compare operations output byte-for-byte after filtering.
pinned_assertions: no restricted data in review queue

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Repeat update ingestion and remove one explicit citation edge in a counterfactual.
cases.setup: Use only the verifier-owned graph and restore/delete only the verifier-owned data.
pinned_assertions: removed citation removes its dependent candidate
old handover and both source versions stay unchanged
cases.failure_detected: Duplicate history, broad queue behavior, or mutation of source artifacts.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Reconnect, normalize a non-UTC timestamp, reject malformed or absent effective time, and inspect effects.
cases.setup: Capture a semantic snapshot after the edge-removal counterfactual immediately before disconnect; reconnect with a new client; compare every semantic field, excluding only graph-query telemetry. Submit invalid synthetic fixtures only to pre-write validation.
pinned_assertions: complete semantic output including source_versions, role_path_evidence, SOP conflict, coverage and review candidates is identical across reconnect
a mutant with source_versions removed is rejected by the same semantic comparator
offset gets new pinned role path
malformed time rejected before graph mutation
missing effective time rejected before graph mutation
cases.failure_detected: Warm-connection cache, silent loss of provenance/history/conflict/coverage after reconnect, guessed time, partial write on invalid input, or side effect.
